# device-endpoint-display

authority(host, port) returns a URL authority string containing a host and integer port. Inputs are a valid unbracketed IPv6 literal, an IPv4 address, or a nonempty DNS hostname; port is in 1..65535. IPv6 literals must be enclosed in one pair of square brackets before adding :port. Preserve the host spelling. IPv4 addresses and DNS hostnames must not gain brackets. No network calls are needed.

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`. Keep public interfaces and the assertions under tests/ unchanged. Python 3.12 standard library only.
